item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.onshape.com/en/blog/ai-generated-thumbnail-description-search","version_id":"b2755a997c3cdda71421bbdd40ee9721d353cbc20ed2f1f80e91169757b9bbd2","decision":"accept","reason":"Relevant, fresh commercial CAD evidence: Onshape says its October 5 Labs release generates searchable descriptions from model thumbnails, allowing natural-language discovery such as “red bracket.” The check described is limited to a released, opt-in feature on public documents; it demonstrates thumbnail-based retrieval, not that geometry, dimensions, manufacturability, or duplicate-part reduction have been validated. Its claims about internal data, supplier catalogs, and reduced duplication are explicitly speculative, so those need customer results or a disclosed retrieval evaluation to withstand scrutiny.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
